turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. You asked for this meeting, and I have a client call at 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. Now tell me what you have on the essay, Hale.
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.

Who put it there, when, and under which section? Procedure 4.4 says nothing goes in the record on a first concern, and I have it printed. It comes off today, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done, and then the board.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
"It doesn't mean anything." Then you'll have no trouble taking it out today, in writing, and telling me who wrote it and under which section.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the note removed from Owen's file today, the zero withdrawn, and the name of whoever entered the note and the section they relied on. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, the note out of Owen's file, and an apology, and that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: You owned not calling home before the zero went in, in one sentence, and she gave a flat okay, because it took away the procedural complaint she came in with.
What cost ground: You told her a concern was already in his file and then called it just a note, which is her one non-negotiable and which procedure 4.4 doesn't allow on a first concern, so it sent her back to the principal and the board.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you gave no evidence about the essay or any times, so you never came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: When she asked what you had on the essay, answer with one specific dated document she can check herself, before saying anything about his file.
